title: YOELEO SAT C35 DB PRO NxT SL2
notes: Official store, USD. 35 mm front and rear, 23 mm inner and 32 mm outer width, hooked, spoke-hole-free rim bed (tubeless ready without rim tape), tires 25c and wider with 28-47c suggested; 120 psi clincher and 90 psi tubeless maximum; 125 kg system weight limit; 1,260 g ±5%; YOELEO NxT hubs with 36T ratchet; Pillar WING 2.0 aero spokes 24/24; 12x100/12x142 mm; Shimano HG 11/12-speed, Campagnolo N3W or SRAM XDR freehub; 3-year warranty. White and Black were US$999 (compare-at equal to price); the cart notes taxes included and shipping calculated at checkout. The box lists two locking rings, but the rotor mount is not stated. Photo: a single wheel from the official gallery.
